summary.name: Oats
summary.one_liner: Oats is a free, open-source Mac app that records meetings on-device without a bot joining the call, then produces AI meeting notes and an action-item todo list.
use_cases: Recording Zoom, Meet, or Teams calls without a bot joining
Getting structured summaries and action items after a meeting
Tracking follow-up todos agreed in meetings
Keeping meeting recordings and notes private on a Mac
Searching across past meeting notes for decisions
Storing meeting notes as Markdown in an Obsidian vault
summary.what_it_does: Oats records audio directly from the Mac with no browser extension or bot joining the call. When a meeting ends, it writes a summary, a quick digest, and action items per person, plus a quality score based on the conversation. Action items collect in a Todos tab, and ticking one off in the notes closes it. Meetings go into a searchable library where users can ask questions across their history. On the local backend, notes are plain Markdown and action items are Obsidian Tasks in a chosen vault.
notable: No bot joins the call; audio is recorded on-device from the Mac
Local notes stored as plain Markdown / Obsidian Tasks in a vault
Fully open source on GitHub, self-hostable
Can run AI locally with a local model or connect an Ariso account
caveats: Speaker tagging is available on the ariso.ai backend for now
Richer AI features require connecting an Ariso account
Page does not list platforms beyond Mac
